settings.title: Viessmann developer account
settings.subtitle: Viessmann Client ID
settings.bodytext: Viessmann's free API plan requires every user to create their own Client ID. It takes about five minutes:

steps.portal: Open the Viessmann developer portal and sign in with your ViCare account (the same email address and password as in the ViCare app):
steps.client: Add a new client and give it a name, for example Homey. Viessmann allows only one client per account: if you already have one (for example for Home Assistant), use it and add the redirect URI from step 4 to it.
steps.recaptcha: Turn Google reCAPTCHA off for the client. Logging in from Homey does not work while it is on.
steps.redirect: Set the redirect URI to exactly this address, with nothing added or missing:
steps.client_id: Save the client in the portal, copy its Client ID, paste it in the field below and press Save.
steps.pair: Add a new device in Homey, choose Viessmann ViCare and log in with your ViCare account.

settings.saved: Client ID saved successfully! You can now add your Viessmann device in Homey.

error.invalid_client_id: Please enter a valid Client ID

problems.title: Common problems

redirect.title: "Invalid redirection URI" on the Viessmann login page
redirect.fix: The redirect URI in your Viessmann client is not exactly right. Open the client in the developer portal, paste the redirect URI from step 4 again, save it and start adding the device again.

no_devices.title: Login works, but no devices are found or an unknown error appears
no_devices.fix: Check that your heating system shows up and is online in the ViCare app. Make sure the Client ID above was saved before you started adding the device. If you saved or changed it just now, close the window for adding devices and start again.

no_oauth2_client.title: "No OAuth2 Client Found" when preparing the report
no_oauth2_client.fix: The report on this page uses the login of an added device. Add a Viessmann ViCare device first, then try again. While adding a device, the report can also be prepared right after the Viessmann login, without adding a device.

reauth.title: Device unavailable after weeks or months ("Authentication failed" or connection lost)
reauth.fix: Short Viessmann outages fix themselves. If the device stays unavailable, your Viessmann login has probably expired, for example after a password change. Open the device, go to its settings, choose Repair and log in with your ViCare account again.

problems.report: Still stuck? Open the Viessmann ViCare app in Homey, send a diagnostic report and briefly describe what you did and what you saw.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.description: The report below shows the data the app gets from Viessmann, which helps the developer when something does not work. It needs at least one added device. Serial numbers, IDs, your address and similar details are anonymized automatically and show up as placeholders such as "anonymized-serial-1". Still, it is best to send it to the developer privately rather than post it publicly.

extra_devices.title: Optional extra devices
extra_devices.text: Besides ViCare, "Add device" offers Heating circuit (thermostat), Hot water (thermostat) and Smart Climate room. Add them only if you need them: a heating circuit as a thermostat of its own (another zone, Google Home, voice), hot water for Google Home or voice, or your ViCare Smart Climate rooms (read-only). Heating circuits and hot water share the updates of the ViCare device and cost no extra API calls; rooms are read every 15 minutes, about 96 calls a day for all rooms together.

health.title: Status
health.description: API calls the app used today per Viessmann account, and the last update of each device. Viessmann allows about 1,450 calls a day per account, shared with other apps that use the same account, and starts counting again at midnight UTC.
health.account: Viessmann account __account__: __used__ API calls today of about __limit__ (counting starts again at __time__), about __planned__ a day planned for updates.
health.no_update: No successful update since the app started.

report.title: Report for the developer
report.description: Can't find your device, or are values missing? This collects what Viessmann reports for your installation and its devices in one step, anonymized. It uses a few API calls. Nothing is sent until you send it yourself.
report.how_to_send: The report is ready. To send it, either open the Viessmann ViCare app in the Homey app (More > Apps), choose Send diagnostic report and say in the message that it is about missing values (the report's __lines__ summary lines are in it), or copy it and send it to the developer privately, for example as a private message on the Homey Community forum.

device_settings.heating_circuit_not_available: Heating circuit __circuit__ is not available on this installation. Available circuits: __available__.
device_settings.too_many_calls: With this setting, this Viessmann account would need about __calls__ API calls a day for updates. Viessmann allows about 1,450 a day and the app keeps a few for other requests, so at most __limit__ are possible. Choose a longer interval here or on another device, or turn the event log off.

pair.no_client_id: No Viessmann Client ID has been saved yet. Open the settings of the Viessmann ViCare app, follow the steps there to create and save a Client ID, then add the device again.
pair.api_limit: The Viessmann API limit has been reached. Try again after __time__.
pair.package_not_paid: Viessmann is refusing access to this account's data. This is often a temporary problem at Viessmann; try again later. If it lasts, contact Viessmann's developer support.
pair.no_installations: No heating system was found for this Viessmann account. Check in the ViCare app that your heating system is set up for the account you logged in with.
pair.no_heating_device: This Viessmann account has no heating device the app can add (found: __types__). A report for the developer helps to add support for it.

client_id.title: Viessmann Client ID
client_id.intro: Viessmann's free API plan needs a Client ID of your own. It takes about five minutes, and you only do it once:
client_id.step: Save the client in the portal, copy its Client ID and paste it below.
client_id.continue: Save and log in to Viessmann
client_id.invalid: This does not look like a Client ID. Copy it from the client in the Viessmann developer portal; it has no spaces.

check.title: Your Viessmann account
check.report_link: Can't find your device or values missing? Prepare data for the developer
check.no_login: Log in to Viessmann first, then try again.

circuit.title: Heating circuit as a thermostat
circuit.who: Add this for each heating circuit you want as a thermostat of its own: in another zone, in Homey's Climate view, or to control with Google Home or by voice. You don't need it otherwise: the ViCare device already shows and controls the heating.
circuit.shared: It uses the Viessmann login and the updates of the ViCare device: no second login and no extra API calls. It also works without the ViCare device.
circuit.none: This Viessmann account has no heating circuit the app can add as a thermostat.

hotWater.title: Hot water as a thermostat
hotWater.who: Add this if you want to control hot water with Google Home or by voice, or see it in Homey's Climate view: it appears as a thermostat with the hot water set point and temperature. Give it a zone of its own and a clear name, so that a command for all thermostats does not change it and its temperature does not count as a room temperature.
hotWater.shared: It uses the Viessmann login and the updates of the ViCare device: no second login and no extra API calls. It also works without the ViCare device.
hotWater.none: This Viessmann account has no hot water with a set point the app can add.

room.title: ViCare Smart Climate rooms
room.who: Add this for each ViCare Smart Climate room you want to see in Homey: its temperature, humidity and set point, read-only (Viessmann's free API cannot change rooms).
room.shared: It uses the app's Viessmann login. At Viessmann the rooms are a device of their own: they are read every 15 minutes, about 96 API calls a day for all rooms together.
room.none: This Viessmann account has no ViCare Smart Climate room with a temperature.

errors.package_not_paid: Viessmann is refusing access to this account's data. This is often a temporary problem at Viessmann; the app tries again every hour. If it lasts, contact Viessmann's developer support.
errors.gateway_offline: The Viessmann gateway is offline. Check that it has power and an internet connection.
errors.api_limit: Viessmann API limit reached, updates resume at __time__.
errors.command_refused: Viessmann refused the change (__detail__). This is sometimes a temporary fault at Viessmann; try again later.

status.fault: The heating system reports fault __codes__. The manual of your heating system explains the code.
status.frozen: Viessmann has sent no new values since __time__. Restarting the internet module of the heating system usually helps: unplug the Vitoconnect for a minute, or switch the heating system off and on again if the module is built in.
status.write_not_applied: The heating system did not take the change: __capability__ is __actual__ instead of __wanted__.
status.refresh_too_soon: The Viessmann features were read a moment ago. Try again in __minutes__ minutes.

flow.value_unknown: No current value from Viessmann yet. Try again after the next update.
flow.rate_limited: Too many changes in a short time (at most __limit__ per hour). Try again in __minutes__ minutes.
flow.not_a_number: The value of __feature__ is not a number.
flow.invalid_parameters: The parameters must be a JSON object, for example {"temperature": 50}, or {} for none.
flow.no_command_metadata: The commands of the device are not known yet. Try again after the next update.
flow.choose_from_list: Choose an entry from the list.
flow.mode_not_supported: Operating mode "__mode__" is not supported by this heating circuit.
flow.write_quota_reserved: The Viessmann account has only __left__ API calls left today, and the regular updates of its devices need them until the daily count resets (__time__). Try again then, or choose a longer update interval in the device settings.
flow.write_burst: Too many changes to this Viessmann account in a short time (at most __limit__ per 10 minutes for all its devices). Try again in __minutes__ minutes.
flow.program_follows_schedule: Normal and reduced follow the device's time program and cannot be chosen directly. Choosing one ends comfort or eco when one of them is on.
flow.program_not_available: This device does not have that program.
flow.mode_not_available: This device has no operating mode for that.
flow.holiday_invalid_date: Enter the holiday dates as DD-MM-YYYY.
flow.holiday_end_before_start: The holiday program must end after it starts.
